provision.quote: The petitioner is before this court calling in question a show cause notice dated 11.05.2023 issued by the respondent under Section 73(1) of the Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017 ('the Act' for short) and all consequential orders that are passed.

financial_years.quote: An ASMT-10 notice is issued to the petitioner for financial year 2017-2018.
